description: Minimum average hot-dip galvanized coating grade by steel category and thickness, in mils, microns and ounces of zinc per square foot, with total zinc for a surface area.

area_sqft.description: Optional surface area to be coated, for the minimum zinc weight.

category.description: shapes = structural shapes (angles, channels, beams); strip = strip and bar; plate; pipe = pipe and tubing; wire; rebar = reinforcing bar.

thickness_in.description: Steel thickness in inches. Give only one of thickness_in, thickness_mm. Default 0.1875 in.

name: galvanizing_coating_thickness_calculator
